description: Search RigBase measured home AI builds. Filter by GPU name, model name, minimum VRAM (GB), and/or maximum build cost. Returns top matches with tok/s, quant, engine, source credit and canonical getrigbase.com URL. Never invents numbers.

currency.description: Optional currency filter: EUR or USD.

gpu.description: Substring to match in the GPUs field (e.g. "3090", "DGX Spark", "5090").

max_price.description: Maximum reported build cost (same currency as the build, usually EUR or USD).

min_vram_gb.description: Minimum total VRAM / unified memory in GB.

model.description: Substring to match a measured model name (e.g. "Qwen3.8", "gpt-oss 120B").

name: search_builds
